name: spawn_subagent
description: Start a short-lived subagent and immediately return its stable agent id. Use observe_subagent for incremental events and wait_subagent for the authoritative terminal result; use send_subagent_input, cancel_subagent, and close_subagent for lifecycle control. You can start multiple independent workers, pass explicit evidence and acceptance criteria, and narrow source scope or tool access.

task.description: The concrete subtask for the delegated agent to complete.

task_id.description: Optional reusable subagent session id. Pass a task_id returned by an earlier subagent result to continue that worker's prior context within the current supervisor turn.

role_id.description: Optional structured role profile. Use researcher, verifier, critic, planner, writer, connector, or desktop_operator when the task matches one of those responsibilities.

role.description: Optional free-form perspective or specialization. Prefer role_id for known profiles, and use role for extra nuance.

model_policy.description: Optional workflow model class. Fast and independent-review phases use a compatible auxiliary model when one is configured for the same provider; otherwise they safely fall back to the parent model.

context.description: Optional context from the supervisor, such as another agent's draft, constraints, or evidence to critique.

expected_output.description: Optional description of the format or deliverable you want back.

acceptance_criteria.description: Optional checklist the subagent should satisfy before returning.

evidence_chunk_ids.description: Optional chunk IDs that should be treated as handed-off evidence from the supervisor.

source_ids.description: Optional narrower source scope for this subagent. When omitted, it inherits the supervisor scope.

allowed_tools.description: Optional narrower tool whitelist for this subagent. Tool names must be from the delegated allowlist.

parallel_group.description: Optional label used when several subagents are exploring sibling branches in parallel.

deliverable_style.description: Optional style hint such as critique, plan, comparison, or verification report.

return_sections.description: Optional ordered section titles the subagent should use in its response.

max_iterations.description: Optional tool-round budget. Zero allows an answer without tools. Omit to inherit the parent round budget; shared delegation token/call limits still apply.

timeout_secs.description: Optional worker deadline in seconds, bounded by the configured delegation run deadline.

agent_config_id.description: Saved provider/account configuration ID from list_subagent_models. Omit to inherit the parent route.

provider.description: Optional configured provider ID. Use agent_config_id when multiple accounts/endpoints share a provider. Never pass credentials or an endpoint.

model.description: Explicit model on the selected route. Omit to inherit its default. This overrides model_policy.

reasoning_effort.description: Optional supported reasoning effort for this worker. Explicit selection takes precedence over automatic role policy.
